appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Coastal Water Temperature Trend'.
Y-axis scale ranges from 0 to 24.0°C, with labeled gridlines at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, and 24.0°C.
X-axis scale ranges from 2005 to 2015, with labeled gridlines for each year.
Data line is a blue line connecting black circular data points.
Each data point is labeled with its corresponding temperature value in °C.
